```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

Everything on this page is a **real component**, rendered by the same code you
see under each preview. Expand *Code* to copy it. The previews recolour with the
light/dark switch in the navbar, exactly as they would in your app.

These are the non-interactive building blocks — the display layer of Tier 1.
For inputs see [Gallery: form inputs](gallery-inputs.html); for dialogs and
menus see [Gallery: overlays](gallery-overlays.html).

## Button

The workhorse. `shad_button()` is an ordinary Shiny action button: give it an
`inputId` and read clicks with `input$id`. Six variants cover the usual intent
hierarchy.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_button("Default")
  shad_button("Secondary", variant = "secondary")
  shad_button("Destructive", variant = "destructive")
  shad_button("Outline", variant = "outline")
  shad_button("Ghost", variant = "ghost")
  shad_button("Link", variant = "link")
})
```

Three sizes, plus an icon-only size. Any [icon name](icons.html) can lead or
trail the label.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_button("Small", size = "sm")
  shad_button("Default")
  shad_button("Large", size = "lg")
  shad_button(icon = "plus", size = "icon", aria_label = "Add")
  shad_button("Continue", icon = "arrow-right", icon_position = "right")
})
```

`loading = TRUE` swaps the icon for a spinner and disables the button; toggle it
from the server around a long task.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_button("Saving…", loading = TRUE)
  shad_button("Disabled", disabled = TRUE)
})
```

## Badge

A small status pill. Same variant vocabulary as buttons.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_badge("Default")
  shad_badge("Secondary", variant = "secondary")
  shad_badge("Destructive", variant = "destructive")
  shad_badge("Outline", variant = "outline")
  shad_badge("Verified", icon = "check")
})
```

## Avatar

An image with a text fallback shown while (or if) the image fails to load.
`shad_avatar_group()` overlaps a set and can cap the overflow with `max`.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_avatar(fallback = "AG")
  shad_avatar(fallback = "SK", size = "lg")
  shad_avatar_group(
    shad_avatar(fallback = "AG"),
    shad_avatar(fallback = "SK"),
    shad_avatar(fallback = "JL"),
    shad_avatar(fallback = "MC"),
    max = 3
  )
})
```

## Card

The primary surface for grouping content. Compose it from the header / title /
description / content / footer parts.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_card(
    shad_card_header(
      shad_card_title("Monthly report"),
      shad_card_description("Revenue and active users, last 30 days.")
    ),
    shad_card_content(
      shad_p("You're up 12.4% month over month.")
    ),
    shad_card_footer(
      shad_button("View report", size = "sm"),
      shad_button("Dismiss", variant = "ghost", size = "sm")
    )
  )
)
```

## Alert

An inline callout. Pair a variant with a matching [icon](icons.html).

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE, {
  shad_alert(
    title = "Heads up",
    "You can add components to your app using the CLI.",
    icon = "info"
  )
  shad_alert(
    title = "Payment failed",
    "Your card was declined. Update your billing details.",
    variant = "destructive",
    icon = "circle-alert"
  )
})
```

## Progress & spinner

`shad_progress()` shows determinate or indeterminate progress; drive its value
from the server with `update_shad_progress()`. `shad_spinner()` is a bare
loading indicator in three sizes.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE, {
  shad_progress(value = 32)
  shad_progress(value = 72)
  shad_progress(indeterminate = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
demo({
  shad_spinner(size = "sm")
  shad_spinner()
  shad_spinner(size = "lg")
  shad_spinner(label = "Loading…")
})
```

## Skeleton

A shimmer placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  tags$div(
    style = "display:flex;gap:0.75rem;align-items:center",
    shad_skeleton(width = "2.75rem", height = "2.75rem", variant = "circle"),
    tags$div(
      style = "display:grid;gap:0.5rem;flex:1",
      shad_skeleton(width = "60%", height = "0.85rem"),
      shad_skeleton(width = "40%", height = "0.85rem")
    )
  )
)
```

## Table

`shad_table()` renders a data frame with optional striping, hover, and a
sticky header.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_table(
    data.frame(
      Invoice = c("INV-001", "INV-002", "INV-003"),
      Status  = c("Paid", "Pending", "Paid"),
      Amount  = c("$250.00", "$150.00", "$350.00"),
      check.names = FALSE
    ),
    striped = TRUE,
    hover = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Item

`shad_item()` is the flexible list row — media, title, description and actions —
used for settings lists, results, and menus. Group them with
`shad_item_group()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_item_group(
    shad_item(
      title = "Design assets",
      description = "24 files · 128 MB",
      media = "folder", media_variant = "icon",
      actions = shad_button("Open", variant = "outline", size = "sm")
    ),
    shad_item_separator(),
    shad_item(
      title = "brand-guidelines.pdf",
      description = "2.4 MB",
      media = "file", media_variant = "icon",
      actions = shad_button(icon = "more-horizontal", size = "icon",
                            variant = "ghost", aria_label = "More")
    )
  )
)
```

## Empty state

`shad_empty()` fills the void when a list or search has no results.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_empty(
    title = "No results found",
    description = "Try adjusting your filters or search terms.",
    media = "search", media_variant = "icon",
    content = shad_button("Clear filters", variant = "outline", size = "sm")
  )
)
```

## kbd & code

Inline helpers for keyboard shortcuts and code fragments.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_kbd("⌘"); shad_kbd("K")
  shad_code("shad_button()")
})
```

## Typography

A tuned type scale. `shad_h1()`–`shad_h4()`, `shad_p()`, `shad_lead()`,
`shad_large()`, `shad_small()`, `shad_muted()`, `shad_blockquote()`, and
`shad_list()`.

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE, {
  shad_h2("The quick brown fox")
  shad_lead("A lead paragraph introduces a section with slightly larger, muted text.")
  shad_p("Body copy sits at a comfortable measure with sensible line height.")
  shad_blockquote("Design systems shouldn't require a toolchain.")
  shad_muted("Muted text for captions and secondary detail.")
})
```
